# Averitt Opens New Distribution And Fulfillment Facility In Jackson, Mississippi

Customers can use the space for overflow inventory

 September 3, 2026 

## New Facility Offers Contract-Free Warehousing

(UCBJ) – Averitt’s 100,000-square-foot Jackson Distribution & Fulfillment facility opened on August 24 th and is located at the crossroads of Interstate 20 and Interstate 55, next door to Averitt’s existing 57-door LTL service center.

The location provides access to key markets, rail connections, and port services through New Orleans and Mobile, while allowing customers to connect warehousing and transportation services in one location.

The new facility offers contract-free warehousing, giving businesses the ability to add space when they need it without committing to a long-term contract. Customers can use the space for overflow inventory, seasonal needs, emergency staging, or a broader distribution and fulfillment solution. # Fulfillment center to bring 1,000 jobs to Hopedale MA. What to know

Caroline Bunnell

The Milford Daily News

July 21, 2026Updated July 22, 2026, 12:19 p.m. ET

Nearly 1,000 new jobs are soon coming to Hopedale as global shipping and logistics company Maersk prepares to open a fulfillment hub in town later this summer.

The announcement arrives as Hopedale has explored new housing and development opportunities in recent years, with officials of the cash-strapped community citing the need for additional revenue and long-term economic growth.

Maersk's 617,000-square-foot facility, at 75 Plain St., will serve as a fulfillment center for the Danish company, which manages ocean shipping, warehousing and supply chain operations for customers all over the world. G10 Fulfillment to Celebrate Grand Opening of New Kenosha Distribution Facility with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony

# G10 Fulfillment to Celebrate Grand Opening of New Kenosha Distribution Facility with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony

 Geneva10 

Sep 01, 2026, 08:34 ET

Mayor and Kenosha County Executive to join company and community leaders in marking the milestone expansion

KENOSHA, Wis., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- G10 Fulfillment, a North American third-party logistics and fulfillment provider, will hold a ribbon-cutting ceremony celebrating the grand opening of its new distribution facility in Kenosha, Wisconsin, on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at 12345 38th Street.

The new 315,000-square-foot facility replaces G10's former Twin Lakes location and more than doubles the company's Midwest warehouse capacity. Positioned along the Chicago–Milwaukee freight corridor, the site supports large-scale order fulfillment and regional inventory distribution as part of G10's broader logistics network.

ColdTrack Expands with New Jacksonville, FL Facility

# ColdTrack Expands Fulfillment Footprint with Brand New Southeast Facility in Jacksonville, Florida

 Daniel Cooke August 4, 2026 August 20th, 2026 

ColdTrack Expands Fulfillment Footprint with Brand New Southeast Facility in Jacksonville, Florida

EDISON, NJ – August 4, 2026 – ColdTrack, the leading provider of pick-and-pack, logistics, and purpose-built software for cold and frozen eCommerce brands, today announced the opening of a new temperature-controlled fulfillment facility in Jacksonville, FL, the second site launched in the last year, significantly increasing reach and improving time-in-transit for perishable brands shipping to the Southeast, especially Miami and southern Florida.

The expansion accommodates the demand created by rapid customer growth and reflects ColdTrack’s broader strategy to strengthen its national fulfillment network in response to evolving direct-to-consumer shipping patterns across the United States.

Grip Expands West Coast Operations With New Reno Facility – Eagle Country

# Grip Expands West Coast Operations With New Reno Facility

September 1, 2026

Written By: EIN Presswire

New Northern Nevada hub extends the category leader’s temperature-controlled fulfillment network across the West

RENO, NV, UNITED STATES, September 1, 2026 / EINPresswire.com/ — Grip, the technology, fulfillment and logistics company revolutionizing the frozen and refrigerated e-commerce space, has opened a 150,000-square-foot facility creating more than 60 jobs in the Reno-Sparks area. The hub is the company’s fifth nationwide and anchors its West Coast operations.

 The facility places Grip within one-day ground shipping reach of approximately 60 million people across 11 Western states, including the Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle and Salt Lake City markets.

 “We chose Reno-Sparks for its strategic location, giving us faster access to major markets across the Western U.S.” said Juan C. Meisel, founder and CEO of Grip. “Paired with our technology, it means our customers get faster, more reliable deliveries at a lower cost.”
